import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";

const B = {
  bg: "#0F0C0A", panel: "#181411", surface: "#1D1915", border: "#272220",
  heading: "#F0EDE8", nav: "#E4DFD5", body: "#C9C1B4", label: "#998F82", faint: "#6B655E",
  blue: "#4A9EF5", hover: "#38BDF8", iron: "#3D444B", slate: "#78828C",
  destructive: "#E5484D", success: "#30A46C",
  headerBg: "#F5F2EF", headerText: "#1A1714", headerSub: "#6B655E", headerAccent: "#2B7DD9",
  orb: "'Orbitron', sans-serif",
  inter: "'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif",
  mono: "'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace",
};

const CUT = 16;

function chamfer(inset = 0) {
  const c = CUT - inset;
  return `polygon(${c}px 0%, calc(100% - ${c}px) 0%, 100% ${c}px, 100% calc(100% - ${c}px), calc(100% - ${c}px) 100%, ${c}px 100%, 0% calc(100% - ${c}px), 0% ${c}px)`;
}

function miniChamfer(c = 5) {
  return `polygon(${c}px 0%, calc(100% - ${c}px) 0%, 100% ${c}px, 100% calc(100% - ${c}px), calc(100% - ${c}px) 100%, ${c}px 100%, 0% calc(100% - ${c}px), 0% ${c}px)`;
}

/* ─── Inset chamfered frame ────────────────────────────────────── */
function LeatherGrain({ seed = 1 }) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const c = ref.current; if (!c) return;
    const w = c.width = 128, h = c.height = 128;
    const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
    const img = ctx.createImageData(w, h);
    let s = seed * 9301 + 49297;
    for (let i = 0; i < img.data.length; i += 4) {
      s = (s * 9301 + 49297) % 233280;
      const v = (s / 233280) * 255;
      img.data[i] = v; img.data[i+1] = v; img.data[i+2] = v; img.data[i+3] = 32;
    }
    ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  }, [seed]);
  return <canvas ref={ref} style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, width: "100%", height: "100%", pointerEvents: "none", zIndex: 5, mixBlendMode: "overlay" }} />;
}

function InsetFrame({ children }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ filter: "drop-shadow(0 6px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)) drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.6))", width: 450, margin: "0 auto" }}>
      {/* Outer border shell */}
      <div style={{ clipPath: chamfer(0), background: "linear-gradient(160deg, #2A2724 0%, #1E1B18 50%, #16130F 100%)", padding: 2, position: "relative" }}>
        {/* ── Subtle 90° gloss — top-down highlight ── */}
        <div style={{
          position: "absolute", inset: 0, pointerEvents: "none", zIndex: 10,
          clipPath: chamfer(0),
          background: "linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 15%, transparent 40%)",
        }} />
        {/* Inner shadow ring — leather textured, widened */}
        <div style={{
          clipPath: chamfer(2),
          background: "linear-gradient(145deg, #0F0C09 0%, #16120E 30%, #1D1812 100%)",
          padding: 8, position: "relative", overflow: "hidden",
        }}>
          <LeatherGrain seed={3} />
          {/* Inner lip */}
          <div style={{
            clipPath: chamfer(5),
            background: "linear-gradient(145deg, #0C0A08 0%, #141110 50%, #1C1915 100%)",
            padding: 2, position: "relative", overflow: "hidden", zIndex: 6,
          }}>
            <LeatherGrain seed={7} />
            <div style={{ clipPath: chamfer(6), overflow: "hidden", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", background: B.bg, position: "relative", zIndex: 6 }}>
              {children}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ─── Header particles ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
function HeaderCanvas() {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const pts = useRef([]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const c = ref.current; if (!c) return;
    const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
    const w = c.width = 460, h = c.height = 80;
    if (!pts.current.length) pts.current = Array.from({ length: 14 }, () => ({
      x: Math.random() * w, y: Math.random() * h,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2, vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.12,
      r: Math.random() * 1 + 0.3, o: Math.random() * 0.25 + 0.05,
    }));
    let raf, frame = 0;
    const draw = () => {
      frame++; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
      const p = pts.current;
      for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < p.length; j++) {
        const dx = p[i].x - p[j].x, dy = p[i].y - p[j].y, d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (d < 70) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p[i].x, p[i].y); ctx.lineTo(p[j].x, p[j].y); ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(74,158,245,${(1 - d / 70) * 0.08})`; ctx.lineWidth = 0.5; ctx.stroke(); }
      }
      p.forEach(pt => {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, pt.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(74,158,245,${pt.o})`; ctx.fill();
        pt.x += pt.vx; pt.y += pt.vy;
        if (pt.x < 0 || pt.x > w) pt.vx *= -1;
        if (pt.y < 0 || pt.y > h) pt.vy *= -1;
      });
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    };
    draw(); return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, []);
  return <canvas ref={ref} style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, width: "100%", height: "100%", pointerEvents: "none" }} />;
}

/* ─── Small components ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
function GearIcon({ size = 13, color }) {
  return <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke={color} strokeWidth="1.3" strokeLinecap="round">
    <circle cx="8" cy="8" r="2.2" /><path d="M8 1.5v1.5M8 13v1.5M1.5 8H3M13 8h1.5M3.4 3.4l1.06 1.06M11.54 11.54l1.06 1.06M3.4 12.6l1.06-1.06M11.54 4.46l1.06-1.06" />
  </svg>;
}

function StatusDot({ state, label, pulse }) {
  const c = { connected: B.blue, disconnected: B.faint, connecting: B.slate, error: B.destructive }[state] || B.faint;
  return <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 5 }}>
    <div style={{ width: 5, height: 5, borderRadius: "50%", background: c, boxShadow: state === "connected" ? `0 0 5px ${c}90` : "none", animation: pulse ? "pulse 2s infinite" : "none" }} />
    <span style={{ fontSize: 9, fontFamily: B.mono, fontWeight: 500, color: c }}>{label}</span>
  </div>;
}

function Tag({ children }) {
  return <span style={{ fontSize: 8, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.faint, padding: "1px 5px", background: B.iron + "40" }}>{children}</span>;
}

function Btn({ label, c, onClick, ld }) {
  const [h, setH] = useState(false);
  return <button onClick={onClick} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)} disabled={ld}
    style={{ padding: "2px 8px", fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 600, fontFamily: B.inter, cursor: ld ? "wait" : "pointer",
      border: `1px solid ${h ? c : c + "40"}`, background: h ? c + "12" : "transparent",
      color: ld ? B.faint : c, transition: "all 0.12s", clipPath: miniChamfer(3),
    }}>{ld ? "···" : label}</button>;
}

/* ─── Product Card ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function ProductCard({ product, onAction, actionLoading }) {
  const [hov, setHov] = useState(false);
  const isR = product.status === "running", isS = product.status === "stopped";
  const isA = product.status === "available", isI = product.status === "installing";
  const sL = isR ? "Running" : isS ? "Stopped" : isI ? "Installing..." : "Available";
  const sS = isR ? "connected" : isI ? "connecting" : "disconnected";
  return (
    <div onMouseEnter={() => setHov(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHov(false)}
      style={{ background: hov ? B.surface : "transparent", border: `1px solid ${hov ? B.border : "transparent"}`,
        padding: "10px 12px", transition: "all 0.12s", clipPath: miniChamfer(6) }}>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, marginBottom: 5 }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 15, width: 22, textAlign: "center", flexShrink: 0 }}>{product.icon}</span>
        <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "baseline", gap: 7 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: B.heading, fontFamily: B.inter }}>{product.name}</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 9, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.faint }}>{product.version}</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: B.label, fontFamily: B.inter, marginTop: 1, lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{product.description}</div>
        </div>
        <StatusDot state={sS} label={sL} pulse={isI} />
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 5, marginLeft: 32, marginBottom: isI ? 6 : 2, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
        {product.arch && <Tag>{product.arch}</Tag>}{product.type && <Tag>{product.type}</Tag>}{product.size && <Tag>{product.size}</Tag>}
      </div>
      {isI && <div style={{ marginLeft: 32, marginTop: 4 }}>
        <div style={{ height: 2, background: B.iron, overflow: "hidden" }}>
          <div style={{ width: `${product.progress || 0}%`, height: "100%", background: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${B.blue}, ${B.hover})`, transition: "width 0.3s", boxShadow: `0 0 4px ${B.blue}30` }} />
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 9, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.faint, marginTop: 2 }}>{product.progressLabel}</div>
      </div>}
      {!isI && (hov || product.updateAvailable) && <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 5, marginLeft: 32, marginTop: 4 }}>
        {isA && <Btn label="Install" c={B.blue} onClick={() => onAction(product.id, "install")} ld={actionLoading === product.id} />}
        {product.updateAvailable && <Btn label={`Update → ${product.latestVersion}`} c={B.hover} onClick={() => onAction(product.id, "update")} ld={actionLoading === product.id} />}
        {isR && <><Btn label="Stop" c={B.slate} onClick={() => onAction(product.id, "stop")} /><Btn label="Restart" c={B.slate} onClick={() => onAction(product.id, "restart")} /></>}
        {isS && <Btn label="Start" c={B.blue} onClick={() => onAction(product.id, "start")} />}
        {(isR || isS) && <Btn label="Logs" c={B.iron} onClick={() => onAction(product.id, "logs")} />}
      </div>}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ─── YODA Chat ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function YodaChat({ connected }) {
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState("");
  const [hist, setHist] = useState([{ from: "yoda", text: "Array3 relay nominal. 2 nodes online. Standing by." }]);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const endRef = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => { endRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" }); }, [hist]);
  const send = useCallback(() => {
    if (!msg.trim() || !connected) return;
    setHist(h => [...h, { from: "user", text: msg.trim() }]); setMsg(""); setSending(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const r = ["Acknowledged. Coordinating with the daemon.", "Running inference pipeline. Stand by.", "Inter-Cube relay: both nodes sync'd. 2.1ms.", "Queued for next build cycle. ETA ~4 min.", "TIS-27 checksums verified — all 40 pass.", "4 products available in catalog. Want me to pre-stage TDNS?"];
      setHist(h => [...h, { from: "yoda", text: r[Math.floor(Math.random() * r.length)] }]); setSending(false);
    }, 1200 + Math.random() * 800);
  }, [msg, connected]);
  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", flex: 1, minHeight: 0 }}>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: "auto", padding: "4px 0", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 6 }}>
        {hist.map((m, i) => <div key={i} style={{ fontSize: 11, lineHeight: 1.6, fontFamily: m.from === "yoda" ? B.mono : B.inter, color: m.from === "yoda" ? B.body : B.nav, paddingLeft: m.from === "user" ? 10 : 0 }}>
          {m.from === "yoda" && <span style={{ color: B.blue, fontWeight: 700, marginRight: 5, fontSize: 10 }}>[YODA]</span>}
          {m.from === "user" && <span style={{ color: B.faint, marginRight: 3 }}>›</span>}
          {m.text}
        </div>)}
        {sending && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.faint }}><span style={{ color: B.blue, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 10 }}>[YODA]</span> <span style={{ animation: "pulse 1s infinite" }}>thinking...</span></div>}
        <div ref={endRef} />
      </div>
      <svg width="100%" height="16" viewBox="0 0 450 16" preserveAspectRatio="none" style={{ display: "block", flexShrink: 0, marginBottom: 6 }}>
        <line x1="0" y1="8" x2="450" y2="8" stroke={B.blue} strokeWidth="0.75" opacity="0.3" />
        <line x1="36" y1="2" x2="36" y2="14" stroke={B.blue} strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.55" />
        <line x1="44" y1="2" x2="44" y2="14" stroke={B.blue} strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.55" />
        <line x1="182" y1="4" x2="182" y2="12" stroke={B.blue} strokeWidth="1" opacity="0.3" />
        <line x1="280" y1="4" x2="280" y2="12" stroke={B.blue} strokeWidth="1" opacity="0.25" />
        <line x1="364" y1="2" x2="364" y2="14" stroke={B.blue} strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.5" />
        <line x1="0" y1="8" x2="8" y2="8" stroke={B.hover} strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.4" />
        <line x1="442" y1="8" x2="450" y2="8" stroke={B.hover} strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.4" />
      </svg>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, flexShrink: 0 }}>
        <input value={msg} onChange={e => setMsg(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === "Enter" && send()}
          placeholder={connected ? "Message YODA..." : "Offline"} disabled={!connected}
          style={{ flex: 1, padding: "6px 10px", border: `1px solid ${B.border}`, background: B.surface, color: B.nav, fontSize: 11, fontFamily: B.mono, outline: "none", clipPath: miniChamfer(4) }} />
        <button onClick={send} disabled={!connected || !msg.trim()} style={{
          padding: "6px 12px", border: `1px solid ${B.blue}30`, background: "transparent",
          color: connected ? B.blue : B.faint, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: B.inter,
          cursor: connected ? "pointer" : "not-allowed", clipPath: miniChamfer(4),
        }}>SEND</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// MAIN
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export default function LauncherWidget() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("yoda");
  const [settingsOpen, setSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [daemon, setDaemon] = useState("connecting");
  const [yoda, setYoda] = useState("connecting");
  const [apiKey, setApiKey] = useState("");
  const [apiKeyValid, setApiKeyValid] = useState(null);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("all");

  useEffect(() => { const t1 = setTimeout(() => setDaemon("connected"), 1400); const t2 = setTimeout(() => setYoda("connected"), 2100); return () => { clearTimeout(t1); clearTimeout(t2); }; }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (daemon !== "connected") return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setProducts([
      { id: "launcher", name: "PlenumNET Launcher", icon: "⬢", description: "Central hub for managing PlenumNET applications", version: "1.0.0", status: "running", type: "tray_agent", arch: "ARM64", size: "1.0 MB" },
      { id: "inter-cube", name: "Inter-Cube Daemon", icon: "◈", description: "WebSocket relay for Array3 mesh networking", version: "0.9.2", status: "running", type: "service", arch: "ARM64", size: "4.2 MB", updateAvailable: true, latestVersion: "0.9.3" },
      { id: "yoda-plat", name: "YODA Platform", icon: "◉", description: "Recursive multi-agent development intelligence", version: "1.1.0", status: "running", type: "hybrid", arch: "ARM64", size: "—" },
      { id: "tdns", name: "TDNS Resolver", icon: "◇", description: "Ternary Domain Name System — ontological addressing", version: "2.5.1", status: "available", type: "service", arch: "ARM64", size: "3.8 MB" },
      { id: "signhere", name: "SignHere", icon: "✦", description: "Post-quantum e-signature — TL-DSA + NinjaExec", version: "1.0.0", status: "available", type: "cli_tool", arch: "ARM64", size: "2.1 MB" },
      { id: "pptpro", name: "PPTPro", icon: "♫", description: "Plenum Pulse Tonal Professor — bio-signal engine", version: "0.8.0", status: "available", type: "hybrid", arch: "ARM64", size: "5.6 MB" },
      { id: "maestro", name: "Maestro ERP", icon: "▣", description: "Construction document management and ERP", version: "2.0.0", status: "available", type: "service", arch: "ARM64", size: "12.4 MB" },
    ]), 500);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [daemon]);

  const validateKey = useCallback(() => { if (!apiKey.trim()) return; setApiKeyValid(null); setTimeout(() => setApiKeyValid(apiKey.length >= 8), 600); }, [apiKey]);

  const handleAction = useCallback((id, action) => {
    if (action === "install") {
      if (!apiKeyValid) { setSettingsOpen(true); return; }
      setActionLoading(id);
      setProducts(ps => ps.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, status: "installing", progress: 0, progressLabel: "Downloading MSI..." } : p));
      let prog = 0;
      const iv = setInterval(() => { prog += 8 + Math.random() * 12; if (prog >= 100) { clearInterval(iv); setProducts(ps => ps.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, status: "stopped", progress: undefined, progressLabel: undefined } : p)); setActionLoading(null); } else { const l = prog < 40 ? "Downloading MSI..." : prog < 70 ? "Verifying TIS-27..." : "Installing..."; setProducts(ps => ps.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, progress: Math.min(prog, 98), progressLabel: l } : p)); } }, 300);
    } else if (action === "start") { setProducts(ps => ps.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, status: "running" } : p)); }
    else if (action === "stop") { setProducts(ps => ps.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, status: "stopped" } : p)); }
    else if (action === "restart") { setProducts(ps => ps.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, status: "stopped" } : p)); setTimeout(() => setProducts(ps => ps.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, status: "running" } : p)), 900); }
    else if (action === "update") {
      setActionLoading(id);
      setProducts(ps => ps.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, status: "installing", progress: 0, progressLabel: "Updating..." } : p));
      let prog = 0;
      const iv = setInterval(() => { prog += 10 + Math.random() * 15; if (prog >= 100) { clearInterval(iv); setProducts(ps => ps.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, status: "running", progress: undefined, progressLabel: undefined, version: p.latestVersion, updateAvailable: false } : p)); setActionLoading(null); } else { setProducts(ps => ps.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, progress: Math.min(prog, 98) } : p)); } }, 250);
    }
  }, [apiKeyValid]);

  const installed = products.filter(p => ["running", "stopped", "installing"].includes(p.status));
  const available = products.filter(p => p.status === "available");
  const filtered = filter === "all" ? products : filter === "installed" ? installed : available;
  const isOn = daemon === "connected";

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", alignItems: "center", minHeight: "100vh", background: "#060504", padding: 32 }}>
      <InsetFrame>
        {/* ═══ LIGHT HEADER ═══════════════════════════════════════ */}
        <div style={{ position: "relative", background: `linear-gradient(180deg, #E4DFD5 0%, #D1CCC6 60%, #C9C1B4 100%)`, padding: "10px 22px 8px", flexShrink: 0 }}>
          <HeaderCanvas />
          {/* ── Subtle 90° gloss on header ── */}
          <div style={{
            position: "absolute", inset: 0, pointerEvents: "none", zIndex: 5,
            background: "linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.18) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 25%, transparent 55%)",
          }} />
          <div style={{ position: "absolute", top: 8, right: 10, zIndex: 6 }}>
              <button onClick={() => setSettingsOpen(!settingsOpen)} style={{ background: "none", border: "none", cursor: "pointer", padding: 4, opacity: settingsOpen ? 1 : 0.5, transition: "opacity 0.15s" }}>
                <GearIcon size={18} color={settingsOpen ? B.headerAccent : B.headerSub} />
              </button>
            </div>
          <div style={{ position: "relative", zIndex: 1, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center" }}>
            <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Capomastro Holdings Ltd." style={{ height: 72, display: "block" }} />
            <div style={{ fontSize: 9, color: B.headerSub, fontFamily: B.mono, letterSpacing: "0.12em", marginTop: 5, textTransform: "uppercase" }}>Applied Physics Division</div>
          </div>
          {isOn && <div style={{ marginTop: 6, padding: "4px 10px", background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.04)", border: "1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05)", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", fontSize: 9, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.headerSub, clipPath: miniChamfer(3) }}>
            <span>ARRAY3</span><span style={{ color: B.headerAccent, fontWeight: 600 }}>◈ 2-node relay</span><span>ws://localhost:21027</span><span>2.1ms</span>
          </div>}
        </div>

        {/* ═══ LEDGE — shadow shelf only ══════════════════════════ */}
        <div style={{ position: "relative", height: 8, background: `linear-gradient(180deg, #B8B0A5 0%, ${B.bg} 100%)`, flexShrink: 0 }}>
          <div style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, height: 6, background: "linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.06) 70%, transparent 100%)" }} />
        </div>

        {/* ═══ DARK BODY ══════════════════════════════════════════ */}
        <div style={{ flex: 1, background: B.bg, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", overflow: "hidden", position: "relative", minHeight: 400 }}>

          {/* Settings overlay */}
          {settingsOpen && <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, zIndex: 50, background: B.bg + "F0", backdropFilter: "blur(6px)", padding: "18px 20px", overflowY: "auto", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 16 }}>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: B.heading }}>Settings</span>
              <Btn label="Close" c={B.faint} onClick={() => setSettingsOpen(false)} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 600, color: B.label, marginBottom: 6, letterSpacing: "0.06em", textTransform: "uppercase", fontFamily: B.mono }}>API Key</div>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6 }}>
                <input type="password" value={apiKey} onChange={e => { setApiKey(e.target.value); setApiKeyValid(null); }} onKeyDown={e => e.key === "Enter" && validateKey()} placeholder="PlenumNET API key"
                  style={{ flex: 1, padding: "6px 10px", border: `1px solid ${apiKeyValid === false ? B.destructive + "40" : B.border}`, background: B.surface, color: B.nav, fontSize: 11, fontFamily: B.mono, outline: "none", clipPath: miniChamfer(4) }} />
                <Btn label="Validate" c={B.blue} onClick={validateKey} />
              </div>
              {apiKeyValid === true && <div style={{ fontSize: 9, color: B.success, marginTop: 4, fontFamily: B.mono }}>✓ Validated</div>}
              {apiKeyValid === false && <div style={{ fontSize: 9, color: B.destructive, marginTop: 4, fontFamily: B.mono }}>✗ Invalid</div>}
            </div>
            <div style={{ height: 1, background: B.border }} />
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 600, color: B.label, marginBottom: 6, letterSpacing: "0.06em", textTransform: "uppercase", fontFamily: B.mono }}>Daemon</div>
              <div style={{ padding: "8px 10px", background: B.surface, border: `1px solid ${B.border}`, clipPath: miniChamfer(4) }}>
                {[["Endpoint", isOn ? "ws://localhost:21027" : "—", isOn ? B.blue : B.faint], ["Array3", isOn ? "2 nodes" : "—", isOn ? B.blue : B.faint], ["Rep C", isOn ? "211.111.111.111.1" : "—", B.slate], ["NinjaExec", isOn ? "Unlocked" : "—", isOn ? B.success : B.faint], ["Arch", "ARM64", B.body], ["Path", "%ProgramFiles%\\Capomastro\\", B.slate]].map(([l, v, c]) => (
                  <div key={l} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: 4, fontSize: 10 }}>
                    <span style={{ color: B.label }}>{l}</span><span style={{ color: c, fontFamily: B.mono, fontWeight: 500 }}>{v}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>}

          {/* Tabs — full-width inset strip */}
          <div style={{
            display: "flex", padding: "0 16px", flexShrink: 0,
            background: "linear-gradient(180deg, #080706 0%, #0C0A09 30%, #0F0D0B 70%, #0A0908 100%)",
            boxShadow: "inset 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), inset 0 -2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04)",
          }}>
            {[{ id: "yoda", label: "Yoda" }, { id: "apps", label: "Apps", count: products.length }, { id: "local", label: "Local" }, { id: "net", label: "Network" }, { id: "apis", label: "APIs" }].map(t => (
              <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setTab(t.id)} style={{
                padding: "9px 10px", border: "none", background: "transparent",
                color: tab === t.id ? B.blue : B.faint, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600,
                fontFamily: B.inter, cursor: "pointer",
                borderBottom: tab === t.id ? `2px solid ${B.blue}` : "2px solid transparent",
                transition: "all 0.12s",
              }}>{t.label}{t.count != null && <span style={{ marginLeft: 4, fontSize: 9, fontFamily: B.mono, opacity: 0.5 }}>{t.count}</span>}</button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Content */}
          <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: "auto", padding: "10px 14px 14px", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>
            {tab === "yoda" && <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", flex: 1 }}>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6, marginBottom: 4 }}>
                <span style={{ color: B.blue, fontSize: 12 }}>◉</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: B.heading }}>Conversational Relay</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 8, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.faint, marginLeft: "auto" }}>NinjaExec · TL-DSA</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ height: 1, background: B.border, marginBottom: 6 }} />
              <YodaChat connected={isOn && yoda === "connected"} />
            </div>}

            {tab === "apps" && <>
              {!isOn ? <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: "44px 20px" }}><div style={{ fontSize: 28, marginBottom: 12, opacity: 0.15 }}>◈</div><div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: B.label }}>Connecting to daemon...</div></div> : <>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 5, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                  {[{ id: "all", label: "All", c: products.length }, { id: "installed", label: "Installed", c: installed.length }, { id: "available", label: "Available", c: available.length }].map(f => (
                    <button key={f.id} onClick={() => setFilter(f.id)} style={{ padding: "2px 8px", fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 600, fontFamily: B.inter, cursor: "pointer", border: `1px solid ${filter === f.id ? B.blue + "30" : "transparent"}`, background: filter === f.id ? B.blue + "0A" : "transparent", color: filter === f.id ? B.blue : B.faint }}>
                      {f.label} <span style={{ fontFamily: B.mono }}>{f.c}</span></button>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 1 }}>
                  {filtered.map(p => <ProductCard key={p.id} product={p} onAction={handleAction} actionLoading={actionLoading} />)}
                </div>
                {available.length > 0 && !apiKeyValid && <div style={{ marginTop: 8, padding: "7px 10px", background: B.surface, fontSize: 10, color: B.label, clipPath: miniChamfer(4) }}>
                  <span style={{ color: B.blue, fontWeight: 600 }}>API key required</span> — <button onClick={() => setSettingsOpen(true)} style={{ background: "none", border: "none", color: B.hover, cursor: "pointer", fontFamily: B.inter, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, padding: 0, textDecoration: "underline" }}>open settings ⚙</button>
                </div>}
              </>}
            </>}

            {tab === "apis" && <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 8 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: B.heading, marginBottom: 2 }}>PlenumNET API Endpoints</div>
              {[
                { name: "CRS", url: "plenumnet.replit.app", status: "live", desc: "Central Registration Service" },
                { name: "Relay", url: "ws://localhost:21027", status: isOn ? "live" : "offline", desc: "Inter-Cube WebSocket relay" },
                { name: "NinjaExec", url: "localhost:21027/sign", status: isOn ? "live" : "offline", desc: "TL-DSA signing service" },
                { name: "YODA", url: "via relay", status: yoda === "connected" ? "live" : "offline", desc: "Multi-agent intelligence" },
                { name: "TDNS", url: "localhost:5353", status: "not installed", desc: "Ternary name resolution" },
                { name: "PPTPro", url: "pptpro.replit.app", status: "live", desc: "Bio-signal tonal engine" },
              ].map(api => <div key={api.name} style={{ padding: "8px 10px", background: B.panel, border: `1px solid ${B.border}`, clipPath: miniChamfer(5) }}>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 3 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: B.heading }}>{api.name}</span>
                  <StatusDot state={api.status === "live" ? "connected" : "disconnected"} label={api.status} />
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 9, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.blue, marginBottom: 2 }}>{api.url}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 9, color: B.faint }}>{api.desc}</div>
              </div>)}
            </div>}

            {tab === "local" && <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 6 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: B.heading, marginBottom: 2 }}>System Resources</div>
              {/* Resource bars */}
              {[
                { label: "CPU", value: 23, detail: "ARM64 Snapdragon X Elite", cores: "12C/12T" },
                { label: "RAM", value: 41, detail: "12.8 / 32 GB", cores: null },
                { label: "GPU", value: 15, detail: "Qualcomm Adreno", cores: "VRAM 2.1 GB" },
                { label: "Disk", value: 62, detail: "298 / 476 GB", cores: "NVMe" },
              ].map(r => <div key={r.label} style={{ padding: "8px 10px", background: B.panel, border: `1px solid ${B.border}`, clipPath: miniChamfer(5) }}>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 4 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: B.heading }}>{r.label}</span>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 9, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.faint }}>{r.cores}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ height: 4, background: B.surface, borderRadius: 2, overflow: "hidden", marginBottom: 4 }}>
                  <div style={{ height: "100%", width: `${r.value}%`, background: r.value > 80 ? "#E5534B" : B.blue, borderRadius: 2, transition: "width 0.5s" }} />
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 9, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.body }}>{r.detail}</span>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 9, fontFamily: B.mono, color: r.value > 80 ? "#E5534B" : B.blue }}>{r.value}%</span>
                </div>
              </div>)}

              {/* AI Models Running */}
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: B.heading, marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 2 }}>AI Models Active</div>
              {[
                { name: "YODA-Core", engine: "Claude Sonnet 4", mem: "via API", status: "running" },
                { name: "NinjaExec-Signer", engine: "TL-DSA local", mem: "48 MB", status: "running" },
                { name: "TTC Encoder", engine: "Tribonacci native", mem: "12 MB", status: "idle" },
              ].map(m => <div key={m.name} style={{ padding: "6px 10px", background: B.panel, border: `1px solid ${B.border}`, clipPath: miniChamfer(4), display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, color: B.heading }}>{m.name}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 9, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.faint }}>{m.engine} · {m.mem}</div>
                </div>
                <StatusDot state={m.status === "running" ? "connected" : "disconnected"} label={m.status} />
              </div>)}

              {/* System info */}
              <div style={{ padding: "6px 10px", background: B.surface, clipPath: miniChamfer(4), fontSize: 9, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.faint, display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "2px 16px" }}>
                <span>OS: Windows 11 ARM64</span><span>Uptime: 4d 7h 22m</span><span>Node: YODA-Prime</span><span>Arch: aarch64</span>
              </div>
            </div>}

            {tab === "net" && <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 6 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: B.heading, marginBottom: 2 }}>PlenumLAN Network</div>

              {/* Array3 topology */}
              <div style={{ padding: "8px 10px", background: B.panel, border: `1px solid ${B.border}`, clipPath: miniChamfer(5) }}>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 6 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: B.heading }}>Array3 Relay Topology</span>
                  <StatusDot state="connected" label="nominal" />
                </div>
                {[
                  { node: "YODA-Prime", addr: "211.111.111.111.1", role: "Gateway", latency: "—" },
                  { node: "SHERWOOD-NAS", addr: "211.111.111.112.0", role: "Storage", latency: "2.1ms" },
                ].map(n => <div key={n.node} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", padding: "4px 0", borderTop: `1px solid ${B.border}` }}>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, color: B.nav }}>{n.node}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 8, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.blue }}>{n.addr}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ textAlign: "right" }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 8, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.faint }}>{n.role}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 8, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.body }}>{n.latency}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>)}
              </div>

              {/* Interfaces */}
              <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, color: B.heading, marginTop: 2 }}>Interfaces</div>
              {[
                { name: "Wi-Fi", ip: "192.168.1.47", ipv6: "fe80::1a2b", speed: "866 Mbps", status: "up" },
                { name: "PlenumLAN vNIC", ip: "10.27.0.1", ipv6: "derived", speed: "10 Gbps", status: isOn ? "up" : "down" },
                { name: "Ethernet", ip: "—", ipv6: "—", speed: "—", status: "down" },
              ].map(iface => <div key={iface.name} style={{ padding: "6px 10px", background: B.panel, border: `1px solid ${B.border}`, clipPath: miniChamfer(4) }}>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 2 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, color: B.heading }}>{iface.name}</span>
                  <StatusDot state={iface.status === "up" ? "connected" : "disconnected"} label={iface.status} />
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 9, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.body, display: "flex", gap: 12 }}>
                  <span>IPv4: {iface.ip}</span><span>IPv6: {iface.ipv6}</span><span>{iface.speed}</span>
                </div>
              </div>)}

              {/* Bandwidth */}
              <div style={{ padding: "6px 10px", background: B.surface, clipPath: miniChamfer(4), fontSize: 9, fontFamily: B.mono, color: B.faint, display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                <span>↑ 1.2 KB/s</span><span>↓ 3.8 KB/s</span><span>Peers: 2</span><span>WS: 1 active</span>
              </div>
            </div>}
          </div>

          {/* Footer — full-width deeply inset channel */}
          <div style={{
            flexShrink: 0,
            background: "linear-gradient(180deg, #080706 0%, #0C0A09 30%, #0F0D0B 70%, #080706 100%)",
            boxShadow: "inset 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), inset 0 -2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04)",
            padding: "6px 16px",
            display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", fontSize: 8, color: B.faint, fontFamily: B.mono, letterSpacing: "0.04em",
          }}>
            <span>LAUNCHER v1.0.0</span><span>SALVI FRAMEWORK</span><span>{isOn ? "◈ CONNECTED" : "CONNECTING..."}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </InsetFrame>

      <style>{`
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@700;800;900&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');
        @keyframes pulse { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0.4} }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px} ::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:${B.bg}} ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:${B.border}}
        *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0} input::placeholder{color:${B.faint}}
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}
